title: The Way of Great Learning
lines: The way of the Great Learning lies in manifesting bright virtue,
Loving the people, and abiding in the highest good.
Only after knowing what to abide in can one be calm.
Only after being calm can one be tranquil.
Only after being tranquil can one achieve peaceful repose.
Only after achieving peaceful repose can one deliberate.
Only after deliberation can one attain the desired end.
Things have their roots and branches.
Affairs have their beginnings and ends.
To know what comes first and what comes last
Is to draw near to the Way.
The ancients who wished to illuminate bright virtue throughout the world
First governed well their own states.
Wishing to govern well their states,
They first cultivated their personal lives.
